    local targets = {}
    for _, p in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild(QDGneEfQjwcacDNAZc('vMPrCZiWKohbmufgTjjTBDMEVHnARhDjCOAlLFiZIUVEAlWDQXBBAdvvstLFjKaBUGDrCWnaNsZJvsySiCWjiUMLgEZHlbAICtceRJTJcAUcAFuEpodhpmbupIRvWqpzZCSdfpoqItMxxzzUWrrGUOWPPgruiTCdzIBtzehJHGqRULGOMDgfbTjIIUUYNcskUYuKoXypSHVtYW5vaWRSb290UGFydA==')) and p.Character:FindFirstChild(QDGneEfQjwcacDNAZc('JYQineWUJptBuSFlwLTbYuAXaMCnvpgQvxSDbQJcxlamBoSqcIcedAfDdAfIUlbqgyhocjoVpqbOSkNFxHsoIeMOjJSuuWQDdpvbfMGTSgihMWKuqbVgDyvNSsqmfaPSflldhGNyargThHhQFesIgsHiRhphEZYqkMsgeySosyuQGevSecDbFLSBlvpDTTjjxNYDAiseSHVtYW5vaWQ=')) and p.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then

local function killLoop()
    while autoKillEnabled do
        local targetChar = getRandomTarget()
        if not targetChar then
            task.wait(0.5)
